held_session_command: inotifywait -m -q -e open -e access -e close_nowrite --format '%e|%w%f' /tmp/prompt-layers-cross-exec/watched.txt > events.log 2> inotify.err & watcher=$!; sleep 0.3; printf 'ready\n' > ready; while [ ! -e stop ]; do sleep 0.1; done; kill $watcher; wait $watcher; cat events.log/inotify.err > result.txt; printf 'done\n' > done
scope: one real cross-exec persistent-session probe; no actor
separate_exec_command: test -f ready; cat watched.txt >/dev/null; printf 'stop\n' > stop; wait for done; cat result.txt
session_completion: poll original yielding exec session after done; exit_code 0
